findings.problem: Pensar is also a common, correct answer for 'to think' meaning 'have an opinion' (pienso que sí, ¿qué piensas?), and the hint doesn't rule it out, so a learner could reasonably answer pensar.
findings.fix: hint: suppose something is so, as in creo que sí for I think so (not pensar)

back.es: to believe; to think (have an opinion, suppose)
back.example: I think it's going to rain.

note: Irregular: true is justified because the preterite has the y spelling (creyó, creyeron), even though the present is regular.
